description: Peephole — born-secure enforcement. PreToolUse gates insecure writes before they land; SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit inject the security ladder and CWE context; PostToolUse logs and retro-scans; Stop enforces the negative-test gate.

hooks.command: R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; E=""; [ -r "$R/bin/.peephole-exe" ] && read -r E < "$R/bin/.peephole-exe"; case "$E" in "$R"/bin/*) if [ -x "$E" ]; then GOMAXPROCS=1 GOGC=off GODEBUG=asyncpreemptoff=1; export GOMAXPROCS GOGC GODEBUG; exec "$E" hook; fi ;; esac; exec sh "$R/hooks/peephole.sh" hook
